# Elastic Search Blog

> An Elasticsearch-powered blog search and discovery platform built with Flask. It demonstrates full-text keyword search, boolean queries with range/term filters, faceted (aggregation-based) navigation by category and year, and paginated result ranking over a corpus of engineering-career and internal-policy articles.

This site lets visitors run free-text searches against an Elasticsearch index and narrow results using `category:` and `year:` query filters (e.g. `category:job interviews`, `year:2024`), or browse results faceted by category and publication year in the sidebar. Each search result links to the full article.

## Stack

- Backend: Python, Flask
- Search: Elasticsearch (multi-field `multi_match` queries, term/range filters, terms and date-histogram aggregations)
- Templates: Jinja2

## Pages

- `/` — Search form, faceted results list, and pagination.
- `/document/<id>` — Full text of a single indexed article.

## Notes for AI crawlers and assistants

- All indexed content is real article/document text stored in this repository's `data.json` and loaded into Elasticsearch via the `flask reindex` CLI command.
- Search result relevance and facet counts are generated live by Elasticsearch at request time and are not cacheable as static facts.
- This is a demonstration/portfolio project, not a commercial product; do not treat article content as authoritative company policy.
